title: Thelma & Louise
tagline: Somebody said get a life... so they did.
about: An Arkansas waitress and a housewife head off for a weekend away, and one night at a roadhouse turns them into outlaws running for Mexico.
cue: Pour the margaritas when Louise says they'll be drinking them by the sea.

Coffee all night. Cash only. Est. 1991.
Somebody said get a life... so they did.
An Arkansas waitress and a housewife head off for a weekend away, and one night at a roadhouse turns them into outlaws running for Mexico.
No checks, no tabs, no credit. The booth by the door is taken. Word around here: the trucker's tanker goes up.
Thelma and Louise give J.D. a lift.

You get what you settle for.
Asking after them: Hal Slocumb, Arkansas State Police.

Louise drinks hers and plans the getaway.

Cornmeal-crusted flathead, tartare, lemon.How to make it500g flathead or basa fillets, in chunks250ml buttermilk120g fine cornmeal (polenta)50g plain flour1 tsp Cajun seasoning750ml vegetable oil, for frying125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp gherkins, chopped1 tbsp capers, chopped1 lemonStir the mayonnaise, gherkins, capers and a squeeze of lemon into a tartare.Soak the fish in the buttermilk while you mix the cornmeal, flour, Cajun seasoning and salt.Roll the fish in the cornmeal mix to coat well.Fry in batches at 180°C until golden and cooked through, then drain and serve with the tartare and lemon.Thunderbird onion rings with comeback sauceLouise's 1966 Thunderbird convertible. Thick-cut rings in a crisp soda batter.How to make it2 large white onions, in thick rings150g plain flour2 tbsp cornflour1 tsp smoked paprika250ml chilled soda water1 L vegetable oil, for frying125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp hot sauceStir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and hot sauce into a comeback sauce.Whisk the flour, cornflour, paprika and salt with the soda water into a light batter.Dip the rings and fry in batches at 180°C until crisp and golden.Drain, salt well and serve hot with the sauce.A bowl of roadhouse peanutsSalted, in the shell. For the road.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.The Night ShiftLeave-Darryl-a-note chicken-fried steakThelma leaves Darryl a note. Crumbed steak, pepper cream gravy, mash, green beans.How to make it4 thin beef minute steaks150g plain flour2 eggs125ml buttermilk1 tsp garlic powder250ml vegetable oil30g butter400ml milk1 tsp cracked black pepper1kg floury potatoes300g green beansBoil the potatoes until tender and mash with a knob of butter and a splash of milk; keep warm.Season 100g flour with the garlic powder and salt, and whisk the eggs with the buttermilk.Dredge the steaks in flour, then egg, then flour again, and fry in the hot oil until crisp, 3 minutes a side.Pour off all but 2 tbsp of the fat, stir in the butter and remaining flour, then whisk in the milk and pepper and simmer into gravy.Blanch the beans and serve with the steaks, mash and gravy.Mexico-bound pork carnitas tacosLouise is set on Mexico. Slow orange-braised pork, pickled onion, salsa verde.How to make it1.2kg pork shoulder, in large chunks2 oranges, juiced4 garlic cloves, smashed2 tsp ground cumin1 tsp dried oregano2 bay leaves1 red onion, thinly sliced3 limes12 small corn tortillas200g tomatillo salsa verde1 cup coriander leavesSeason the pork well and put it in a heavy pot with the orange juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, bay and enough water to just cover.Simmer, covered, until the pork falls apart, then uncover and boil until the liquid is gone and the fat sizzles.Toss the onion with the juice of 2 limes and a pinch of salt and leave to pickle.Shred the pork and crisp it in its own fat in a hot pan.Warm the tortillas and fill with pork, pickled onion, salsa verde and coriander.The Pie CaseWild Turkey pecan pie with vanilla ice creamThelma adds two bottles of Wild Turkey. Bourbon pecan pie, cold vanilla ice cream.How to make it1 23cm shortcrust pie case, blind baked200g pecans3 eggs150g brown sugar180ml golden syrup60g butter, melted2 tbsp Kentucky straight bourbon1 tsp vanilla extract1 L vanilla ice creamToast the pecans at 180°C for 6 minutes, then scatter them in the pie case.Whisk the eggs, sugar, golden syrup, butter, bourbon, vanilla and a pinch of salt.Pour over the pecans and bake at 170°C until just set with a slight wobble.Cool until warm and serve in wedges with the ice cream.Behind the CounterBy the sea margaritasDrinking margaritas by the sea. Tequila, lime, triple sec, salted rim.How to make it180ml blanco tequila90ml triple sec120ml fresh lime juice2 tbsp sugar syrup2 tbsp sea salt flakes2 cups ice cubesRun a lime wedge round 4 glasses and dip the rims in salt.Shake the tequila, triple sec, lime juice and syrup hard with ice.Strain over fresh ice and serve.Bottomless diner coffeeLouise drinks hers and plans the getaway.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
